steps.name: Step 2 — Click the 'Business Analyst' category filter-rail chip
Step 3 — Click the 'Elitea' category filter-rail chip while 'Business Analyst' remains selected
Step 4 — Verify both 'Business Analyst' and 'Elitea' category sections are displayed, and no others
Step 5 — Verify section headers 'Business Analyst' and 'Elitea' appear, 'Business Analyst' positioned before 'Elitea'
Step 6 — Verify agents from both 'Business Analyst' and 'Elitea' are displayed in their respective sections, and no cards from other categories
Step 7 — Verify zero console errors during the multi-click filter interaction
